job.title: Sr. Engineering Manager - Payments
job.description: Lead two Payments engineering teams through platform modernization, including decoupling payment capabilities from business logic, improving observability, performance, reliability, and operational health. Manage engineering managers and individual contributors, guide technical direction with senior engineers, own third-party payment integrations, and partner with Product and Commercial on payment capabilities and priorities. Drive cross-team initiatives, develop talent, and balance product delivery with foundational architecture investments.
responsibilities: Partner with staff and principal engineers to lead the Payments Pillar through the evolution of Cedar’s Payments architecture, including decoupling payment capabilities from business logic.
Lead, coach and develop Engineering Managers and individual contributors across the Payments Pillar.
Establish and improve the metrics and instrumentation used to understand performance across payment features and workflows.
Partner with Product and Commercial to balance new payment capabilities and performance improvements with foundational architecture and operational investments.
Own the engineering relationship and technical outcomes for third-party payment vendor integrations.
Identify opportunities to and lead initiatives that enable multiple teams to deliver results more effectively.

positioning: Prioritize bullets showing ownership, reliability, and cross-functional delivery impact.
project_suggestions: Highlight projects touching Experience managing managers, their performance, reliability
gap_analysis: Add quantified outcomes (latency, uptime, delivery speed, or cost savings) where possible.
